name: ID documents - random frame split
blurb: Real ResNet50 features from 4,600 MIDV-500 video frames, split by shuffling frames. Scores 97.2% - and EvalGuard shows why that number is not real.

name: ID documents - document-design split
blurb: The same frames, re-split so entire document designs are held out. The leakage is gone and accuracy falls to 82.6% - but the variance check shows even that number swings by 11 points depending on which designs you hold out.

name: Fraud detection - imbalanced classes
blurb: Synthetic. 94.9% accuracy sounds strong until you notice that always guessing 'legitimate' scores 94.5%.
